Changes to the upstream firmware itself are better sent to
[meshtastic/firmware](https://github.com/meshtastic/firmware) than here. This
repository only carries the Traditional Chinese display and Bopomofo input
method, and tracks upstream releases.

Please describe what the change does and why.

## Attestations

- [ ] Every `_zhtw` environment this touches still builds.
- [ ] The stock environment next to it still builds, unchanged.
- [ ] Changes to the rendering or input path were tested on hardware. If you do
      not have the device, say so, so someone with one can test it.

Devices in use here: GAT562 Family, Seeed Wio Tracker L1 / L1 Pro,
Heltec V3, M5Stack Cardputer Adv.
